user.title: Connect to llama-swap
user.description: Enter the address of your llama-swap server. The API key is only needed if llama-swap is configured with one.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the machine running llama-swap.
data_description.port: The port llama-swap listens on (8080 by default).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate llama-swap
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Enter the current key, or leave it blank if llama-swap no longer requires one.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by llama-swap.

abort.already_configured: This llama-swap server is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll llama-swap, in seconds.

load_model.name: Load model
load_model.description: Loads a model into memory. Returns once llama-swap reports the model is ready, which can take a while for large models.

model.name: Model
model.description: The model ID, as listed by llama-swap.

config_entry_id.name: llama-swap server
config_entry_id.description: Which server to act on. Only needed when more than one is configured.

unload_model.name: Unload model
unload_model.description: Stops one model and frees its memory.
